title: MySQL: TABLE_DROPPED and MYSQL_BINLOG_FILE_DELETED show the flow's raw text, not the catalog message

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: MySQL 8.4.13, standard gateway, one run each

symptom: A dropped table: flow error eventType TABLE_DROPPED, "Flow ... has failed because of a fatal error during realtime phase". A binlog file purged past the gateway's position: eventType MYSQL_BINLOG_FILE_DELETED, with the same raw text. The catalog texts ("Table has been dropped on source", "MySQL binlog file ... has been deleted from the source server.") didn't appear.
effect: The customer sees the event type and the flow's name, not the explanation.
fix: Read the eventType and the flow's table name from the gateway's events, and look the type up in this reference.
notes: The binlog case needed the gateway stopped while its binlogs were purged. The position-unreadable case didn't fire in this run.
